defs.def: tidy and in order; carefully done or arranged 整洁的；整齐的；有序的

ex.s: Make sure your handwriting is neat.
Hey, that’s kind of neat,'" Parry recalled.
ex.t: 嘿，那还挺酷的，”帕里回忆道。

ex.s: These pieces can be folded into a neat little pack and fastened on your belt.
ex.t: 这些部件可以折叠成一个小巧整齐的包，扣在你的腰带上。

ex.s: When Marilla came upfor the light, she sawthe untidy waythe clothing had been thrown on thefloor.Shecarefullypicked upAnne's clothes,placed them neatly on a yellow chair, and then, taking up the candle, went over to the bed.
ex.t: 玛丽拉走上来看灯火时，她看到衣服被胡乱扔在地板上的凌乱样子。她小心地捡起安妮的衣服，整齐地放在一把黄色的椅子上，然后拿起蜡烛，走到床边。

ex.s: To help them keep control over the city,the Emperors during these periods arranged different areas of Beijing in neat blocks of houses built around courtyards.
ex.t: 为了帮助他们保持对城市的控制，这些时期的皇帝们将北京的不同区域规划成围绕庭院建造的整齐街区。

ex.s: Make sure all words and pictures are laid out neatly and beautifully.
ex.t: 确保所有文字和图片都排列得整洁美观。

ex.s: B: If we keep the grass looking really neat, maybe people will realise they shouldn’t walk on it.
ex.t: B：如果我们把草坪保持得非常整洁，也许人们会意识到不应该在上面走。

ex.s: For example, most city parks are kept neat and tidy so that humans will find them beautiful.
ex.t: 例如，大多数城市公园都保持干净整洁，这样人们才会觉得它们美丽。
